description: Single source for every value that depends on the technical namespace. The namespace is halumar and frozen. Functional names (cookies hub_session/hub_csrf, header X-Hub-Integration-Version, env HUB_*, compliance label hub/compliance/v1) do not depend on the namespace and are not listed. Display names belong to brand.json.

ha_domain.used_in: HA integration domain, service domain (halumar.start_pairing), config entry, custom_components/<domain>

ha_control_action.used_in: HA action through which devices with the control path checked switch; apps call it as call_service domain halumar, service control

ha_ws_family_command.used_in: HA WebSocket command of the family manager away from home (schemas/integration/ha-ws-family.command.json)

ha_ws_family_subscribe_command.used_in: HA WebSocket subscription to the family pushes (schemas/integration/ha-ws-family-subscribe.command.json)

ha_alarm_event.used_in: HA event fired by the integration for every alarm event

ha_event_event.used_in: HA event fired for every event of the taxonomy (data/events.json)

ha_tag_scanned_event.used_in: HA event fired by the integration when a device resolved a tag (schemas/integration/ha-tag-scanned.event.json)

ha_event_prefix.used_in: HA events halumar_client_connected, halumar_client_disconnected, halumar_client_area_changed, halumar_pairing_started, halumar_pairing_stopped, halumar_guest_expired, halumar_event and halumar_alarm

ha_device_identifier_hub.used_in: HA device registry identifier of the hub device, GET /api/integration/devices

addon_slug.used_in: config.yaml slug, add-on folder in halumar/hub, image ghcr.io/halumar/{arch}-hub (the image name is functional, not namespaced)

bonjour_service_type.used_in: mDNS announcement of the hub; discovered by the apps (Info.plist NSBonjourServices without .local. on Apple, network service discovery on Android)

deep_link_scheme.used_in: pairing QR / copy link halumar://pair?..., iOS CFBundleURLSchemes and the Android intent filters (the only accepted scheme, no aliases)

deep_link_pair_tv_prefix.used_in: onboarding QR of the Apple TV as development link halumar://pair-tv#… (simulators without Associated Domains); production QR is https://<brand website>/pair-tv#…; also the direct-mode TV sign-in link

deep_link_tag_prefix.used_in: development form of the tag link halumar://t/<tag_id> (docs/links.md); production https://<brand website>/t/<tag_id> (Associated Domains, Android App Links)

deep_link_open_prefix.used_in: app form of the open link halumar://open/<view> (docs/links.md): officially allowed next to the preferred https://<brand website>/open/<view>, opens views only; for automations on devices without verified universal links / App Links (e.g. Google TV via androidtv_remote)

config_sensor.used_in: client_config.config_sensor; the area overview sensor the hub writes

client_quick_access_sensor_template.used_in: client_config.quick_access.sensor, check sensor of widgets and controls; clients never derive it themselves

ha_compliance_path.used_in: HA Core HTTP view registered by the integration, polled by the iPhone and iPad app

ha_device_token_client_name_prefix.used_in: client_name of the long-lived token of a per-device HA user: halumar:<client_id>, after a rotation halumar:<client_id>/<hex6>. Marks integration-owned device users for the reconcile (integration const.DEVICE_TOKEN_CLIENT_NAME_PREFIX).

integration_hub_object_id_prefix.used_in: object ids of the integration hub entities (sensor.halumar_hub_version, button.halumar_hub_start_pairing, ...); built from the domain, never from the display name

integration_client_object_id_template.used_in: object ids of the integration client entities (sensor.halumar_wall_tablet_notifications)
